model_note: Check ElevenLabs' models page for the current recommended narration model before the first run, and note the date you checked here.
voice_settings_note: null uses the chosen voice's own defaults. Set stability, similarity_boost, style or speed here, never per script. Any change here re-voices every line.
stitching_note: Sends the previous and next lines as previous_text and next_text so the clips flow together.
